title: THE CARD DOES NOT CLAIM SHARED POWER-UPS
why: From the cloud review of the party builds: the What is New card said power-ups are shared in the two player game, which is not true. Each window drops power-ups for its own kills and the pickups belong to that window, nothing about them goes over the link. The card now says each player has his own power-ups.
now: The What is New card says each player has his own power-ups.
